premises.text: Medication non-adherence is a significant issue for patients with chronic respiratory illnesses
premises.evidence_span: $80 billion is spent each year treating respiratory illness, of which half of that is attributed to medication non-adherence

premises.text: Current respiratory devices are outdated and do not effectively support patient adherence
premises.evidence_span: bulky and intimidating spirometer, a device that has not evolved in function or form since it was first introduced in 1840

premises.text: Smart respiratory devices can improve medication adherence and patient outcomes
premises.evidence_span: we at Cohero Health are making respiratory devices data smart to enable improved adherence, leading to better patient outcomes for pulmonary patients

premises.text: Wireless medication inhaler sensors can track medication utilization in real time
premises.evidence_span: we enable her with wireless medication inhaler sensors to track her medication utilization and adherence in real time

premises.text: A mobile spirometer can provide clinical-grade lung function measurements from home
premises.evidence_span: a clinical-grade and ultra-portable mobile spirometer, which measures her lung function from home

premises.text: A connected health platform can provide transparency and data access for patients and doctors
premises.evidence_span: empowering respiratory patients to take control of their treatment and also have transparency with regards to how that treatment is improving their health

premises.text: The Cohero Health system can significantly increase medication adherence and reduce emergency room visits
premises.evidence_span: we were able to demonstrate two and a half times increase in medication adherence over the standard of care

value.text: Patients with chronic respiratory illnesses can manage their conditions more effectively and improve their health outcomes
value.evidence_span: empowering respiratory patients to take control of their treatment and also have transparency with regards to how that treatment is improving their health

notes: Traction metrics and funding details excluded as they do not support premise claims.
